INSERT INTO recent_searches (
                id,
                user_id,
                raw_query,
                normalized_query,
                last_searched_at,
                created_at,
                updated_at
            )
            VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $5, $5)
            ON CONFLICT (user_id, normalized_query) DO UPDATE SET
                raw_query = EXCLUDED.raw_query,
                last_searched_at = EXCLUDED.last_searched_at,
                updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
            RETURNING
                id,
                user_id,
                raw_query,
                normalized_query,
                last_searched_at,
                created_at,
                updated_at
